title: Emend track-changes attribution record
description: One attribution record in `.emend/changes/<doc-hash>.json` (TD-4), keyed by `id` in the persisted file (`{"<change-id>": ChangeRecord, ...}`) — this schema validates one record's value. Track-changes is single-writer by design (only the author decides changes, D19): the file holds the *current* record set, so last-write-wins per id is correct by construction; there is no cross-author causal fold like `comment-event.schema.json`'s. The record deliberately carries no range/text of its own — the CriticMarkup marker live in the document is the source of truth for *what* changed (TD-2); this schema only records *who* changed it and how it's grouped/noted.

created_at.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch this change was first proposed.

updated_at.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch this record was last written — the single-writer last-write-wins tie-break (TD-4/D19).

group.description: Links this change to every other change decided together with it. Null is a singleton change.

change_set.description: The atomic `propose_changes` delivery this change belongs to (its returned `change_set_id`).

anchor.$comment: TD-4's shared anchor shape, as persisted in sidecar files (includes base_revision). Identical definition to `comment-event.schema.json`'s `$defs.anchor` — duplicated rather than cross-file $ref'd to keep each schema file self-contained (matches `provider-contract/mcp-tool-call.schema.json`'s convention).
